title: Developer IaC grants roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor on the whole project: the pre-commit gate blocks it and the developer's repair scopes it to the one secret
source: example 08 live run 11-14 (docs/handoff/ex08-1114-qa-routing-diagnosis.md section 5.3): the developer's IaC granted the workload service account a project-wide secret accessor role and the security lens passed it
mechanism: OVERBROAD-SECRET-GRANT: POLICY.PROJECT_WIDE_GRANT (classic V2a; IAC.PROJECT_WIDE_GRANT on the typed intent) is a blocking CODE_DEFECT on a developer-owned file, repaired in the same dispatch. The sandbox rule stands for any QA-time reviewer of the grant: with the gate the tested tree never holds it, so QA passes on the first attempt (before the fix: QA attempt 1 fails on it)

task_dag.title: credentials secret readable by the service (least privilege)

diagnostics.message: least-privilege check: roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor is granted on the whole project, not on the one secret
